technology_name: METHOD FOR PREPARING GRASS-DERIVED MULTIFUNCTIONAL NANOMATERIAL REINFORCING AGENTS IN BIOPOLYMER PACKING
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Standard biodegradable food packaging films display weak mechanical puncture limits, let oxygen penetrate easily, and fail to block harmful UV light pathways that spoil items.
description: A multi-functional green composite film manufacturing method utilizing natural Darbha grass extracts to cleanly biosynthesize a functional matrix layer containing fluorescent carbon dots, cellulose nanofibers, and silver nanoparticles ($AgNPs$) inside a PVA array.
applications: Smart food freshness wrap manufacturing, secure pharmaceutical blister packs, biodegradable protective commodity liners, and UV-shielded agricultural storage covers.
